findings.text: the after_suite records revision f26287e as the passing run, but at that revision the suite cannot run: reckon/run_store.py at f26287e has no stamp_refusal (reproduced here as AttributeError: 'RunStore' object has no attribute 'stamp_refusal' against the committed tree alone). The 9-test pass was obtained on a transiently-provisioned run_store, which the manifest discloses under evidence_inputs; at the merged head (the stamping API is on main) the full gate does reproduce, so this is a recording-fidelity note rather than a change defect — a reader must know the listed revision is not where the 9 passed.

the module docstring states the file's concern as shape-conditioned lane evidence ('This module never ranks, selects, or recommends a lane') and says nothing about the binding-window inference that now shares the file, so the declared purpose is narrower than the module's contents.

justifications.durability: tests/test_binding_window_inference.py guards every state the measure names: the 5h/weekly, 30h/short, and single/undetermined verdicts, plus cross-lane isolation and an unparseable refused_at being skipped — each verified at the merged head for this review (9 passed, 0.60s), so a regression in infer_binding_window fails tests rather than surfacing silently; nothing yet consumes the verdict, which the run correctly records as a follow_on.
justifications.evidence: the manifest's numbers independently reproduce: merged-head gate 9 passed / 0 failed (5 inference + 4 chassis) and base chassis 4 passed, delta 0, re-run in a scratch merged-head overlay of the reviewed commit over the current run_store; the three named states are asserted against stamps written and read back through RunStore.refusal_stamps, not literals; the sole caveat is the after_suite revision label (see finding), and the ~5h band edges (4h/3.5h/6.5h) appear only in the run's REPL evidence, not in committed tests.
justifications.fit: infer_binding_window follows the module idiom — a dict verdict carrying a stated reason, module-scope named constants (SHORT_WINDOW_HOURS, RESET_CROSSING_TOLERANCE) a surface can tune, and _moment mirroring the existing _number guard style — and is parameterized per lane though only spark needs it in production; the one seam is the module docstring that has not absorbed the new concern.
justifications.goal_fidelity: all three states the measure requires are asserted exactly: two refusals 5h apart report weekly with pairs[0].reset_crossed True, two 30h apart report short, and a single refusal reports undetermined rather than guessing — the state a surface is most tempted to fake is asserted outright, and stamps are read from the real store API a later surface would read.
justifications.scope_discipline: commit f26287e changes exactly the two declared write paths — reckon/crew/lane_evidence.py (+94) and tests/test_binding_window_inference.py (+114), 208 insertions, no other file touched (reckon/run_store.py untouched in the commit); path and content naming checks on both files find no plan, sprint or version labels and no changelog prose.
